name: CAMEL
summary: Open-source Python multi-agent framework from CAMEL-AI for role-playing agents, data generation, task automation and large-scale world simulation.
description: Research-oriented framework (`pip install camel-ai`) with ChatAgent, multi-agent societies and workforces, toolkits (including MCP), memory, RAG and synthetic data generation; it originated with the 2023 CAMEL role-playing paper. PyPI `camel-ai` 0.2.90; pre-releases 0.2.91a* (September 2026).
